name: copy-reference
description: Copy a fully qualified reference to the PHP, JavaScript or TypeScript symbol under the cursor, like PhpStorm's Copy Reference.

scripts.test:integration: node out/test/integration/runTests.js intelephense php && node out/test/integration/runTests.js phptools php && node out/test/integration/runTests.js js js && node out/test/integration/runTests.js none none && node out/test/integration/runTests.js none command
scripts.test:docker: docker build -f test/docker/Dockerfile -t copy-reference-test . && docker run --rm copy-reference-test
